headline: Fatty

headline: What Can

headline: Stopped
Drinking?
frames.scene: A liver model above an ordinary scene where a hand sets a wine glass aside; water is nearby.
frames.jtbd: After stopping drinking, I want to record my own days and observations without being judged.
frames.visualLimit: Alcohol-specific context, not an explanation of all fatty liver. No repair, recovery timeline or treatment efficacy depicted.
